title: Flottila flow file, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over, P0-12)
description: One flow: where messages come from, how they are delivered and recorded, the finite limits every flow has, and the ordered steps. Component- and step-specific keys are passed through to the component's or step's own configSchema at deploy time.

id.description: Flow id, unique in its package; the identity is tenant / package / flow:id @ version.

from.description: The consumer endpoint this flow listens on, plus the component's own options.

mode.description: ARCHITECTURE §4 message lifecycle per delivery mode.

saveTimeout.description: at-least-once: the durable save deadline before NACK/503 (default 5s).

queue.description: at-least-once: the work queue behind the durable save.

limits.description: Every flow has a finite max body size; never a default of unlimited (CLAUDE.md).

maxInFlight.description: Admission budget: requests in flight for this flow. Omitted = the runtime's finite default (cores × 2 for CPU-heavy flows, ARCHITECTURE §4), never unlimited.

maxInFlightBytes.description: Admission budget: bytes in flight for this flow. Omitted = the runtime's finite default (per-flow byte budget, ARCHITECTURE §14), never unlimited.

partitionBy.description: Business key that orders messages (same key, same order).

forwardHeaders.description: Allow-list of ingress headers that reach producers; nothing propagates implicitly.

retry.description: Per-step retry policy for steps marked retryable: exponential backoff between initial and max.

type.description: Step type. The schema knows the typed requirements of xslt, xsd, route, to, extractKey, validate and split; any other type passes here and is checked against its step's own configSchema at deploy time (an unknown type, e.g. a typo, fails there, not here).

name.description: Step name, unique in the flow; the label on snapshots and per-step timings (camelCase allowed).

stylesheet.description: Path of the XSLT file relative to this flow file.

schema.description: Path of the XSD file relative to this flow file.

xpath.description: Selects the parts; every selected node becomes a child message.
